In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the source of excess calories in obesity has a significant influence on the development of obesity and on gene expression in the adipocyte.
the composition of the diet has a major impact on obesity and that the genes that are altered in the obese state persist following weight reduction.
the composition of a high-fat diet influences adipocyte gene expression and may influence the development of obesity and its metabolic consequences.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the effects of obesity are more severe and persistent when the energy source is high in fat.

differences in diet composition have significant effects on adipocyte gene expression and obesity, and that the source of excess dietary energy may influence the expression of obesity-associated genes.

diet composition influences the development of obesity and that the source of excess calories influences the expression of genes that may play a role not only in the pathogenesis of obesity but also in the metabolic response to weight loss.
The main takeaway from our work is that
obesity is associated with a large number of differentially expressed genes.
the source of excess calories may have an important influence in obesity, and the composition of diet during weight reduction may also have an influence on gene expression and metabolism.
obesity is a disease that is characterized by changes in gene expression that persist following weight reduction and that may contribute to weight regain.
